name: ele-win-reader
author: Metahumanz
description: A modern desktop reader application built with Electron and Vue

scripts.build: rimraf release dist dist-electron && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build: rimraf release dist dist-electron && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: rimraf release dist dist-electron && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: rimraf release dist dist-electron && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux
